data.body: CORRECTION to note compaction-budget-spec-recorded: the 8,000-token summary cap and the 2,512-token minimum replacement were absolute limits and are gone as of 1a0f8e6. Every budget is now a share of W: T = floor(0.25W); B = max(T - F, floor(0.08W)); S = min(floor(0.382 B), declared output reservation); R = B - S. The spec document was rewritten to match (title now "Compaction budget model: every budget is a share of the window"). At F = 12,400: 100k -> R 7,787 / S 4,813; 262k -> 32,839 / 20,297; 1M -> 154,342 / 95,402, ratio R:S constant at 0.618:0.382. minimum_window(F) = ceil(F/0.17) = 72,942 at F = 12,400 (was 59,648) and can_reduce is F + floor(0.08W) < 0.8W. The only non-context bound is the model's own declared output, so a local model declaring 8,000 output tokens bounds itself (1M -> R 241,744 / S 8,000). SUMMARY_BUDGET_SHARE = 0.382 is the one ratio with no derivation: prose against verbatim history.
